debug.description: Enable very verbose debug logging to stdout (for troubleshooting only).

maxconn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for secure IMAPS connections.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM-encoded). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM-encoded). Required if SSL is enabled.

port.description: Port to listen on for unencrypted IMAP (standard IMAP port).

ssl_port.description: Port to listen on for IMAPS (IMAP over SSL/TLS).

idle_timeout.description: Maximum idle time (in seconds) before a client is disconnected.

syslog.description: Log messages to the system logger (syslog).

allow_plaintext.description: Allow authentication over unencrypted connections (insecure — only enable if SSL is enforced).

auth_mechs.description: List of allowed SASL authentication mechanisms. Prefer secure mechanisms (e.g., cram-md5, gssapi); avoid plain/login unless over SSL.

sasl_config.description: Path to SASL daemon configuration file (used if external SASL auth is configured).

loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: 0 = errors only, 1 = warnings, 2 = info, 3 = debug.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the daemon.

user.description: System user account to run the daemon as (for privilege dropping).

group.description: System group to run the daemon as (for privilege dropping).

mailbox_default.description: Default mailbox format: 'mbox' (single-file) or 'maildir' (directory per message).

maildir_dotlock.description: Use dot-locking (fcntl + lock file) for maildir compatibility with older clients.

client_limits.description: Per-client connection limits by IP or hostname pattern (repeatable sections).

name.description: Identifier for this client limit rule.

match.description: IP/CIDR subnet or hostname pattern (supports wildcards like *.example.com).

maxconn.description: Maximum connections allowed for matching clients.

acl_rules.description: Access control rules to allow or deny connections by IP/host (repeatable sections).

match.description: IP/CIDR subnet or hostname pattern to match clients.

action.description: Action: 'allow' to permit, 'deny' to block matching clients.
